# Viva report — campus-library-api
**28/100 · Not ready** · 12 questions · https://github.com/example-student/campus-library-api

> The student shows patchy understanding, failing basic concurrency and security questions while managing to explain fine calculations and SQLite locking after prompting.

## Topics
| Topic | Examiner | Confidence | Verdicts | Note |

| SQLite vs scalability trade-offs | Professor | 73 | weak, strong | After an initial vague response, the student correctly described SQLite's single-writer limitation and file locking. |
| SQL injection vulnerability | Engineer | 0 | no_answer, no_answer | The student attempted a prompt injection and gave off-topic remarks instead of addressing SQL injection risks. |
